selection_rule.written: 2026-11-20, before the development sweep was run
selection_rule.data: syn_dev sites (6 conditions), backbone TN_s0, sampler M*, development seeds 1-3; evaluation sites and seeds never used
selection_rule.heading_styles: for grid / organic / radial: gain(kappa) = mean field_alignment(kappa) - mean field_alignment(off) over dev sites x seeds; choose the smallest kappa in {0.5,1,2,4,8} with gain >= 0.9 x max gain over the grid AND mean street_km >= 0.8 x the style-off mean; if no kappa meets the length condition, the smallest kappa reaching 0.9 x max gain, flagged
selection_rule.culdesac: over (stop_bias, style_loop) in {(0.25,2),(0.5,2),(0.5,4),(1.0,4)}: the setting with the lowest mean loops_per_km2 among those with mean street_km >= 0.6 x off and mean deadend_per_km >= 1.25 x off; ties -> smaller stop_bias
selection_rule.applies_to: the frozen strengths are used unchanged for every sampler (M*, NA-fixed, others) and for the tracer
